Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Ashapura Minechem reported its best financial year in history for FY26, driven by significant top-line and profit margin growth across its Guinea and India operations. Management highlighted key challenges including rising fuel, freight, and input costs, along with anticipated bauxite quota implementations in Guinea. The company plans to expand port and beneficiation capacities while focusing on value-added products and new product developments in India. Management remains optimistic about long-term growth and expects stable to improved performance in the coming year. Ashapura Minechem Limited held its Q3 FY26 earnings conference call, discussing operational performance affected by prolonged monsoons in Guinea and raw material volatility in India.

guidance.claim: The management targets bauxite volumes in the range of 10 to 12 million tons for the next year.
guidance.quote: our target for the year after next is 15 million, and this year we are expecting broadly a range of 10 to 12 million tons for next year

guidance.claim: Management reiterated confidence in achieving the long-term volume target of 15 million tons for FY27-FY28.
guidance.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are very confident of achieving our long-term volume target of 15 million tons.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated confidence in achieving the target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.
guidance.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are confident of achieving our target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that aluminium metal is currently trading at about $3,600 and is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton.
demand_outlook.quote: As such, the metal is doing very good, aluminium metal currently is trading at about $3,600 which is expected to go up to $4,000 per ton and that will have again some positive impact on the consumption of bauxite in coming months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the world can absorb up to 300 million tons of bauxites every year.
demand_outlook.quote: So, you can see that there will be some, initially there will be some gap between supply and demand, and over a time they will slowly they will fill up this gap.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that bauxite inventory levels in China are at an all-time low.
demand_outlook.quote: The inventory in China at the moment is all-time low.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects demand and buying inquiries to pick up after the Chinese Spring Festival and Chinese New Year.
demand_outlook.quote: We are waiting for the Chinese Spring Festival time, Chinese New Year time, and after that we could see that there will be some upward trend in the bauxite price.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that bauxite prices have declined about 4%-5% over the last 90 days, but demand continues to be very stable.
demand_outlook.quote: However, the demand for bauxite continues to be very stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that production volumes are fully committed for calendar year FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Our production volumes are fully committed for calendar year FY'26.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that demand for bleaching clay from the edible oil sector is strong and increasing.
demand_outlook.quote: We see a strong and increasing demand from the edible oil sector, where your company commands over 70% market share in the premium clay segment in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to expand port facilities to increase volume capacity from 15 million tons to 20 million tons by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is looking at a significant capex of roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions over the next year.
capex_expansion.quote: We are, therefore, looking at a significant capex over the next year, roughly around INR150 crores across all business divisions, to upgrade our plant facilities and add new products to our portfolio.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated investment for the BOFFA bridge in Guinea would be in excess of about Rs. 80 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated investment, we do not have the exact figure as on today, but it would be in excess of about Rs. 80 crore.

capex_expansion.claim: The company started production in two new bentonite mines in Kutch after receiving all clearances recently.
capex_expansion.quote: We would like to share that we have started production in two new bentonite mines in Kutch after receiving all clearances recently.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated profit margin grew by 48% during the financial year.
margins_costs.quote: As you are aware that we have -- our top line has grown about 105%, and our -- the profit margin has gone 48% during this year.

margins_costs.claim: Logistics-intensive operations faced increases in fuel prices and transportation costs that impacted margins.
margins_costs.quote: Given the logistics-intensive nature of our operations, increases in fuel prices and transportation costs had an impact on margins across businesses.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for quarter three stood at INR143 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for quarter three stood at INR143 crores, which is a growth of 8.3% quarter-on-quarter. Margin is 14.9%, which was 13.9% in quarter two.

margins_costs.claim: New freight contracts at the load port are now on CQD terms, which means no demurrage is applicable.
margins_costs.quote: Our future -- our future freight contracts at the load port, we have now working on CQD terms. So in CQD terms, there is no demurrage is applicable.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 stood at Rs. 952.5 crore, reflecting growth of around 57% year on year.
margins_costs.quote: consolidated revenue from operation for the current quarter that is Quarter 2 stood at Rs. 952.5 crore, reflecting growth of around 57% year on year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q2 FY26 doubled year on year to Rs. 132.1 crore with a 102.6% growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the Quarter 2, '26 doubled year on year which was Rs. 132.1 crore and 102.6% growth that is 13.9% which was 10.8% in last quarter of '25.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue for H1 stood at Rs. 2,308 crore, reflecting growth of around 75% year on year.
margins_costs.quote: consolidated revenue for H1 stood at Rs. 2,308 crore, reflecting growth of around 75% year on year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for H1 FY26 came to Rs. 319.9 crore, up 105% year on year.
margins_costs.quote: Talking about EBITDA, H1, '26 came to Rs. 319.9 crore which is up 105% year on year with margin percentage of 13.9% compared to 11.8 in H1 of 25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per metric ton of Guinea bauxite was USD 8.9 compared to USD 9.3 in Quarter 1.
margins_costs.quote: It was USD 8.9 per metric ton compared to USD 9.3 per metric ton in Quarter 1, supported largely by improved internal operational efficiency

orders_capacity.claim: Export of bauxite from Guinea reached almost 8 million tons in the last year against 3.5 million tons in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: In the last year, we have ended almost the export of 8 million tons of bauxite against 3.5 million tons in the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is putting up a bauxite washing plant with a capacity of 20,000 tons per day.
orders_capacity.quote: We are also putting up the bauxite washing plant with the capacity of 20,000 tons per day which will help us to use the bauxite which is currently is not a marketable quality

orders_capacity.claim: Guinea contributed around 76% to revenue in quarter three, and India contributed 24.2%.
orders_capacity.quote: Guinea contributed around 76% to revenue in quarter three, and India contributed 24.2%.

orders_capacity.claim: In the second quarter, the company exported 1.33 million tons of bauxite.
orders_capacity.quote: in this quarter, we have done export of 1.33 million tons of bauxite which is almost double when compared to the previous corresponding quarter of last financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: In the first half of FY26, the company exported 3.38 million metric tons of bauxite.
orders_capacity.quote: In the first half of FY'26, we exported 3.38 million metric tons of bauxite.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects to distribute 300,000 tons annually from the two new bentonite mines in Kutch.
orders_capacity.quote: We expect to distribute 300,000 tons annually, which will improve the cost structure and the sales potential for this vertical.

orders_capacity.claim: The Paddhar Kaolin plant is currently close to complete capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are close to complete capacity utilization at our Paddhar Kaolin plant.

orders_capacity.claim: Bleaching clay continues to operate at near full capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Bleaching clay, a forward integration of our bentonite mineral, continues to operate at near full capacity utilization, backed by robust demand from edible oil refiners.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a dividend of 100% for the fiscal year subject to shareholders' approval.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a dividend of 100% for the fiscal year, subject to shareholders' approval, which reflects both our confidence in the business and our commitment to rewarding shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that debt is close to its peak.
capital_allocation.quote: We expect at least that the debt is close to its peak or at peak really.

capital_allocation.claim: A 9-megawatt solar plant linked to the bleaching clay plant under the group captive model has helped lower power costs.
capital_allocation.quote: The recent commissioning of our 9-megawatt solar plant, which is linked to this bleaching clay plant under the group captive model, has helped to lower cost and reinforce our sustainability goals.

capital_allocation.claim: APL owns 26% of the solar SPV.
capital_allocation.quote: Please note, APL owns 26% of the solar SPV.

risks_headwinds.claim: Profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix with a higher proportion of lower-margin products.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, profitability was affected by higher input costs and changes in product mix, with a higher proportion of lower-margin products contributing to overall sales.

risks_headwinds.claim: Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Within our portfolio, the performance of our Specialty Adsorbent Solutions business was impacted by a sharp increase in sulfuric acid prices, which is a key raw material used in this business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prolonged monsoon in Guinea impacted operations and affected overall performance during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prolonged monsoon in Guinea had impacted our operations and affecting our overall performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Indian operations faced headwinds mainly due to volatility in raw material costs and climatic changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: the Indian operations also have seen some headwinds mainly due to volatility in the raw material cost and the climatic changes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that bauxite prices saw a correction of approximately 3% along with a stronger local currency.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite an approximate 3% correction in bauxite prices and a stronger local currency, EBITDA per metric ton of Guinea bauxite has dropped very slightly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that there was some monsoon impact for the month of October.
risks_headwinds.quote: I would like to highlight that there was some monsoon impact for the month of October.

management_commitments.claim: The second port expansion at GSM port is expected to add capacity by the end of FY27-28.
management_commitments.quote: So, that is our second port, GSM port, which should also add another 50% to 60% to that port's capacity.

management_commitments.claim: The port facilities expansion to increase volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons is expected to be ready by the end of this year.
management_commitments.quote: However, we are doing the expansion in our port facilities which will be expected to be ready by end of this year and we will be able to increase our volume from 15 million tons to 20 million tons.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates closing long-term freight arrangements with big shipping operators in the next few months.
management_commitments.quote: At the same time, we also are in touch with some big shipping operators to have a long-term arrangements for the freight and hopefully, we will be able to close this kind of contract in next few months.

management_commitments.claim: Income tax liability in Guinea will not exist for at least the next one or two years.
management_commitments.quote: And for at least, I can say, the next one or two years, there won't be any tax liability at least to Ashapura.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve the long-term bauxite volume target of 15 million tons by FY27-FY28.
management_commitments.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are very confident of achieving our long-term volume target of 15 million tons. This is for the ‘27- ‘28 as we -- as we have stated.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to commercialize iron ore further within the next two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: We are expected to commercialize further within the next two quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management reiterated confidence of achieving the target of 15 million metric tons in FY27-28.
management_commitments.quote: We would like to reiterate that we are confident of achieving our target of 15 million metric tons in FY'27-'28.

management_commitments.claim: R&D cost reaching 2%-3% of PAT is a medium-term goal.
management_commitments.quote: going forward, maybe we can reach 2%-3% of PAT, which we think is sufficient for the size of our Company and the kind of business we are in. I think 2%-3% could be a medium-term goal.

management_commitments.claim: The BOFFA and GSM port expansion remains on track to complete by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our BOFFA and GSM port expansion remains on track to complete by Q2 FY'27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
